raw.description: 战斗开始时，自身双防值的15%提升至速度外的能力值，之后自身存活于出战背包时，双方的主动下场均视为驱逐下场，己方的系别无法被对手剥离|回合开始时，若自身不处于能力提升状态，则己方免疫下1次受到的异常状态、自身当回合免疫秒杀；对手执行的异常状态附加效果概率低于100%时，自身获得1层气吞山河|双方先出手时，令对手PP值最低的首位技能PP值-1，若对手此技能PP值为0，则自身恢复所有的PP值并获得2回合八方真武帝|双方后出手后，自身恢复双防值25%的体力并附加恢复量的百分比伤害，对手免疫百分比伤害时改为令对手石化且自身获得2回合八方真武帝（boss无效）

review.rationale: 药剂排除、气吞实际概率执行资格及八方属性直伤边界按原答和公共执行定义落实；真实初始面板、最低PP、后手魂印回复等保留。
review.singleBehavior: 开战双防15%面板一次加速度外五项；回初无正强1次免异与当回免秒杀，敌原正异常执行最终概率<100每轮1层气吞最高5，每层增红减红20%，满5永久八方。双方实际技能先手均作用玄武对手最低PP，归0则自身全PP和2回八方；后手实际技能使玄武魂印回双防25%并按净回粉伤，敌免粉改石化+八方。药剂自身不触发，另一个真正技能不被封。八方免红/明确属性直伤/固/粉，不免真伤、不免非伤害HP交换。
review.deferredBehavior: 己方其他真实成员的免异/系别保护；双方真实主动下场转驱逐；气吞山河真实下场保留，场下魂印来源作用于当前双方。
review.trigger: 持有者存活于真实出战背包、其他己方成员受异常/系别剥离、双方主动下场、持有者真正下场后再次登场
futureMechanisms: 实际背包和场下魂印事件
真实队伍状态与层数跨场保留

dependencyEvidence.quote: 双方的主动下场均视为驱逐下场

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 4995/2144气吞来自五回合真实低概率冻伤执行，5层永久八方，100%异常和能力弱化不计
success.assertion: test('4995/2144气吞来自五回合真实低概率冻伤执行，5层永久八方，100%异常和能力弱化不计',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4823/snapshot.json'),s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[33280,10001,20177,10361,38114]});for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){turn(s,20276,33280);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.layers,i);}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor2144.permanent,true);const x=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[38549,20276,20565,11141,38550]});x.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations=x.moveDefinitions[key(38549)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1447);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulId,2144);turn(x,20276,38549);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.layers,0);const y=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[11144,20276,20565,11141,38550]});assert.equal(y.fighters[0].soulId,2144);turn(y,20276,11144);assert.equal(y.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.layers,0);});

success.name: 4995/2144气吞每层实际攻击增伤20%及受攻减伤20%，层数不同不改面板
success.assertion: test('4995/2144气吞每层实际攻击增伤20%及受攻减伤20%，层数不同不改面板',()=>{const a=make({move:11141,soul:true}),b=structuredClone(a);E.SOULS.registry[2144].abilities.gain({a:a.fighters[0],round:1});turn(a,11141,10127);turn(b,11141,10127);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(a)/red(b)-1.2)<.03);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(a,1)/red(b,1)-.8)<.04);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].stats,b.fighters[0].stats);});

success.name: 4995/2144当前自身系别剥离保护接入真实3847技能2284，非魂印对照正常剥离且异常免疫失败仍剥离
success.assertion: test('4995/2144当前自身系别剥离保护接入真实3847技能2284，非魂印对照正常剥离且异常免疫失败仍剥离',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/3847.json').snapshot;for(const soul of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[29011,10250,21684,11599,33208]});s.moveDefinitions[key(29011)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(29011)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===2284);timer(s,0,'免异常',{});const type=s.fighters[0].type;turn(s,20276,29011);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,soul?type:'普通');if(soul)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.typedContracts,undefined);}});

success.name: 4995/2144八方两回合到期，命中效果失效封锁被强执绕过而普通红伤不归零
success.assertion: test('4995/2144八方两回合到期，命中效果失效封锁被强执绕过而普通红伤不归零',()=>{const s=make({move:29463,index:4,loadout:[29463,20276,20565,11141,38550]});E.SOULS.registry[2144].abilities.grant({round:1},s.fighters[0]);timer(s,0,'属性技能命中效果失效',{});turn(s,29463,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);for(const k of Object.keys(s.fighters[0].stages))s.fighters[0].stages[k]=0;turn(s,29463,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);for(const k of Object.keys(s.fighters[0].stages))s.fighters[0].stages[k]=0;turn(s,29463,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);});

success.name: 4995/2144属性分类不使4950御将1792属性红伤当作攻击伤害反弹，普通攻击仍反弹
success.assertion: test('4995/2144属性分类不使4950御将1792属性红伤当作攻击伤害反弹，普通攻击仍反弹',()=>{const G=require('./helpers/remaining-4950.cjs');for(const attribute of[false,true]){const s=G.make({move:38568,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[27925,10250,20065,10628,35797]});s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1792);G.turn(s,38568,20065);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');G.turn(s,29467,attribute?27925:10250);const es=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2),incoming=es.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),reflected=es.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='true').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0);assert.ok(incoming>0);assert.equal(reflected,attribute?0:incoming);}});

success.name: 4995/2144属性分类使4947上一回合攻击记录排除1792属性伤害，保留本方真实攻击红伤
success.assertion: test('4995/2144属性分类使4947上一回合攻击记录排除1792属性伤害，保留本方真实攻击红伤',()=>{const G=require('./helpers/remaining-4947.cjs');const s=G.make({move:38541,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[27925,10250,20065,10628,35797]});s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1792);G.turn(s,38541,27925);const own=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.some(e=>e.redCategory==='attribute'&&e.settledDamage>0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147?.record?.amount??s.fighters[0].soulState.war2147?.record?.amount,own);});

success.name: 4995/2144八方免真实4355属性直伤1792，护盾按实际HP损失为零；普通对照受伤授盾并独立记录属性分类
success.assertion: test('4995/2144八方免真实4355属性直伤1792，护盾按实际HP损失为零；普通对照受伤授盾并独立记录属性分类',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/4355.json').snapshot;for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[27925,10250,20065,10628,35797]});s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(27925)].operations.filter(o=>o.effectId===1792);if(immune)grant(s);turn(s,20276,27925);const ev=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(ev.redCategory,'attribute');assert.equal(ev.settledDamage,immune?0:300*E.typeEffectiveness('光 暗影',s.fighters[0].type,s.typeChart));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000-ev.hpLoss);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,ev.hpLoss);}});

success.name: 4995/2144八方原无效攻击红伤仍0，命中词条执行且不触发2593无效补偿
success.assertion: test('4995/2144八方原无效攻击红伤仍0，命中词条执行且不触发2593无效补偿',()=>{const s=make({move:38548,index:2});grant(s);timer(s,0,'attackBlock',{});turn(s,38548,20309);assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,300);const x=make({move:38548,index:3});grant(x);timer(x,0,'attackBlock',{});timer(x,1,'免弱',{});turn(x,38548,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].ailments['石化'],undefined);assert.ok(x.fighters[1].effects['免弱']);});

success.name: 4995/2144八方对攻击固定百分比免疫而不免真实伤害和直接体力消耗
success.assertion: test('4995/2144八方对攻击固定百分比免疫而不免真实伤害和直接体力消耗',()=>{for(const type of['fixed','percent','true','direct']){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1}),old=E.SOULS;grant(s);let observed;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,123,'真实结算测试',type);observed=hp-c.t.hp;}}};try{turn(s,20276,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(observed,['fixed','percent'].includes(type)?0:123,type);}const a=make({move:20276,index:-1});grant(a);turn(a,20276,10127);assert.equal(red(a,1),0);});

success.name: 4995/2144开战双防面板15%一次性提升速度外五项，不含能力等级，正零负初始等级基数相同
success.assertion: test('4995/2144开战双防面板15%一次性提升速度外五项，不含能力等级，正零负初始等级基数相同',()=>{for(const rank of[-3,0,3]){const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeBattleStart'&&c.a.side===0)c.a.stages.def=rank;old.run(e,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].stats,{maxHp:9090,atk:270,def:390,spa:270,spd:390,spe:500});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9090);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,rank);}});

success.name: 4995/2144回初无强同源免异1刷新不累加，有强不新增；免秒杀只挡公开秒杀通路不挡普通致死伤害
success.assertion: test('4995/2144回初无强同源免异1刷新不累加，有强不新增；免秒杀只挡公开秒杀通路不挡普通致死伤害',()=>{const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true});for(let i=0;i<2;i++){turn(s,20276,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);}s.fighters[0].counts.immune=0;s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;turn(s,20276,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);const x=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{spe:500}}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.soulInstantKill4706(c.t,'共享秒杀管线测试');old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(x,20276,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(x.fighters[0].hp>0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.instantImmune2144Round,1);const death=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1},bStats:{spe:500}});turn(death,20276,10127);assert.equal(death.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(death.finished,true);});

success.name: 4995/2144无论哪方先手均扣玄武对手最低首位PP，零PP回满及八方归玄武，不偷换为行动方
success.assertion: test('4995/2144无论哪方先手均扣玄武对手最低首位PP，零PP回满及八方归玄武，不偷换为行动方',()=>{for(const slow of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,aStats:{spe:slow?1:500},bStats:{spe:slow?500:1}});s.fighters[0].pp[key(20276)]=2;s.fighters[0].pp[key(29463)]=1;s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)]=1;s.fighters[1].pp[key(10716)]=1;turn(s,20276,10127);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.ppEvents[0];assert.equal(e.actorSide,slow?1:0);assert.equal(e.beneficiarySide,0);assert.equal(e.key,key(20117));assert.equal(e.after,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(10716)],1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor2144);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.emperor2144,undefined);const src=require('./helpers/remaining-4995.cjs').source;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(20276)],src.moves.find(m=>m.id===20276).pp-(slow?1:0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29463)],src.moves.find(m=>m.id===29463).pp);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);}});

success.name: 4995/2144后手动作触发玄武自身双防25%净回复和等量粉伤，不给对手回血；免粉改石化及八方与回复并行
success.assertion: test('4995/2144后手动作触发玄武自身双防25%净回复和等量粉伤，不给对手回血；免粉改石化及八方与回复并行',()=>{const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,20276,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1195);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),195);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,8805);const x=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});x.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(x,20276,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,1195);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].ailments['石化'],undefined);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.emperor2144.end,2);});

success.name: 4995/2144真实4823冻伤50%成功判定和失败判定均获气吞1，免异失败不豁免执行，同轮不超过1层
success.assertion: test('4995/2144真实4823冻伤50%成功判定和失败判定均获气吞1，免异失败不豁免执行，同轮不超过1层',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4823/snapshot.json'),seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=20;seed++){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[33280,10001,20177,10361,38114],seed:seed*987654321});turn(s,20276,33280);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.layers,1);seen.add(s.fighters[0].counts.immune);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['冻伤'],undefined);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[0,1]);});

success.name: 4995/2144气吞逐层最高5每轮一次与永久八方，药剂不触发但混合回合真实后手技能仍触发
success.assertion: test('4995/2144气吞逐层最高5每轮一次与永久八方，药剂不触发但混合回合真实后手技能仍触发',()=>{const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true}),a=s.fighters[0],ability=E.SOULS.registry[2144].abilities;for(let round=1;round<=5;round++){assert.equal(ability.gain({a,round}),true);assert.equal(ability.gain({a,round}),false);}assert.equal(a.soulState.xuan2144.layers,5);assert.equal(a.soulState.emperor2144.permanent,true);assert.equal(ability.gain({a,round:6}),false);const x=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(x,null,20309);assert.equal(x.round,2);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,1445);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.xuan2144.ppEvents,undefined);});

success.name: 4995已答药剂不触发双方先后手：双血药只各自回血，混合回合保留真正技能的先手扣PP和后手回复附粉

interaction.assertion: test('4995八方不把真实3683零红后的HP交换冒充属性伤害，交换实际降HP且无正伤害事件',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/3683.json').snapshot,raw=enemy.moves.find(m=>m.id===38526),fifth=enemy.moves.find(m=>m.fifth).id,loadout=[38526,...enemy.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth&&m.id!==38526).slice(-3).map(m=>m.id),fifth],s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:loadout,targetHp:1000});E.SOULS.registry[2144].abilities.grant({round:1},s.fighters[0]);const index=raw.effectInstances.findIndex(e=>e.id===2496),op=s.moveDefinitions[key(38526)].operations.find(o=>o.index===index);s.moveDefinitions[key(38526)].operations=[op];const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let hp;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const out=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase===op.phase&&c.a?.side===1&&c.m?.wikiId===38526)hp=c.t.hp;return out;}};try{turn(s,20276,38526);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(hp,1000);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp<9000);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).some(e=>e.targetSide===0&&e.settledDamage>0),false);});

success.assertion: test('4995/32要害率加成五回合有效，76真实5回合100持续固伤及10%分支成功失败，44只对特攻减半',()=>{const crit=make({move:20566});turn(crit,20566,20309);assert.equal(crit.fighters[0].effects['要害概率增加'].chance,1/16);assert.equal(crit.fighters[0].effects['要害概率增加'].end,5);const s=make({move:11143,loadout:[11143,20276,11141,20565,38550]});for(let round=1;round<=6;round++){turn(s,round===1?11143:20276,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),round<=5?100:0);}const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64&&seen.size<2;seed++){const x=make({move:11146,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,11146,20309);seen.add(sum(x,'fixed')===25);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);for(const special of[false,true]){const a=make({move:20567,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[10667,11141,20276,20565,38550]}),b=make({move:20567,index:-1,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[10667,11141,20276,20565,38550]});turn(a,20567,special?10667:11141);turn(b,20567,special?10667:11141);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(a,1)/red(b,1)-(special?.5:1))<.03);}});

success.name: 4995/32要害率加成五回合有效，76真实5回合100持续固伤及10%分支成功失败，44只对特攻减半
success.assertion: test('4995/32要害率加成五回合有效，76真实5回合100持续固伤及10%分支成功失败，44只对特攻减半',()=>{const crit=make({move:20566});turn(crit,20566,20309);assert.equal(crit.fighters[0].effects['要害概率增加'].chance,1/16);assert.equal(crit.fighters[0].effects['要害概率增加'].end,5);const s=make({move:11143,loadout:[11143,20276,11141,20565,38550]});for(let round=1;round<=6;round++){turn(s,round===1?11143:20276,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),round<=5?100:0);}const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64&&seen.size<2;seed++){const x=make({move:11146,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,11146,20309);seen.add(sum(x,'fixed')===25);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);for(const special of[false,true]){const a=make({move:20567,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[10667,11141,20276,20565,38550]}),b=make({move:20567,index:-1,enemySource:source,enemyLoadout:[10667,11141,20276,20565,38550]});turn(a,20567,special?10667:11141);turn(b,20567,special?10667:11141);assert.ok(Math.abs(red(a,1)/red(b,1)-(special?.5:1))<.03);}});

review.rationale: Q002不计算等级，实际面板包括已结算魂印面板增量，和免红/免固交互验证。

review.singleBehavior: 当次红伤为0且敌存活则按实际防御面板附固定伤害，不计防御等级，固定伤害免疫独立。

success.name: 4995/2592命中零红仍附防御面板固伤，免固独立，防御正负等级不改变基数
success.assertion: test('4995/2592命中零红仍附防御面板固伤，免固独立，防御正负等级不改变基数',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38550,index:2});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(s,38550,20309);assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);}for(const n of[-1,1]){const s=make({move:38550,index:2});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});s.fighters[0].stages.def=n;turn(s,38550,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,n);assert.equal(s.round,2);}});

success.name: 4995全部22真实招各16种子原生魂印与完整已知链可执行，缺PP拒绝且不耗回合
success.assertion: test('4995全部22真实招各16种子原生魂印与完整已知链可执行，缺PP拒绝且不耗回合',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true,seed:seed*987654321});turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});
